I had no idea that there were serious rules to buying gold fish.
The girl acted like the Goldfish mafia. She took it to a level that was offensive.
I was interrogated too.

But I understand protecting our animals and providing the proper environment,  but  help customers by educating and explaining the reasons why buying a simple goldfish is different now a days.
Don't talk down to me,  and be condescending.

I took the harsh info and bought what was needed else where and I'm glad my money was spent at a pet shop that was much nicer and pleasant. I now have a beautiful  filtered tank and all the bells and whistles filled with 3 fishes 🥰🩷💕

I’m still in shock at the treatment I received at this location. I’m not sure if the groomer was having a bad day, generally an unkind person, or  racist. Upon checking in, the groomer was very rude, cold, and unwelcoming.  I was told I would receive a call when it was time to pick up my pup and that it would take 2-3 hours. I never received a call. When I came to pick my dog up 3 hours later, the groomer was extremely rude and accused me of lying about not receiving a call. I will never return to this location and would not trust my dog in her care.

This happened 2 months ago and my plans were to never go to this location again, but I discovered she also put an unwarranted restriction on my account to prevent me from booking with Petco again. Needless to say I will keep my loyalties with Pet Smart from now on.

I also see now that at least one other black woman had a similar experience so I assume this is a pattern of behavior. I hope management deals with this accordingly before it results in a lawsuit.
